input: Directional revamp session, bet #3: one page per high-traffic e-invoice rule (BR-DE set + 30 EN 16931/Peppol) in EN/DE/FR, generated from data, tests that every id exists in the cited source version
task: einvoice-preflight/rules: 74 rule pages x 3 languages from rules/data/*.json
errors: inherited_keys.py flagged SOURCES[rule.source]; replaced with sourceOf() using Object.hasOwn.

doc_friction.issue: The manifest records commits but not release versions; the XRechnung set is master one commit after v2.6.0, found only via git ls-remote and a shallow clone. Recording the release tag at build time would save the next citer that step.

deviations.why: The brief asks for the 30 most common EN 16931/Peppol rules, but no frequency data exists in the repo or publicly.
deviations.did: Picked 35 (22 EN 16931, 13 Peppol) by judgement from the rules the checker's examples and fixes hit, and said so on the README and in the post.
deviations.result: Selection is labelled as judgement, not a measured ranking.

deviations.why: Writing 74 x 3 explanations is parallel work.
deviations.did: Five subagents wrote the data files from the compiled rule tests; I reviewed samples, verified six quirk claims against the XPath, and ran two snippet checks against the official engine.

notes: Verification: node --test rules/rules.test.mjs 10/10 (with slimdom+fontoxpath installed: BR-DE-2 and BR-DE-9 snippets put into examples/ubl-invoice.xml silence those rules under the official XRechnung Schematron; the BR-DE-18 snippet passes, a missing trailing line break and a decimal comma fire BR-DE-18). platform/pages faq-visible, secondary-schema, css-lint: 16/16. run_venture_tests.py einvoice-preflight: 2771 of 2772 pass; the one failure is repair-facturx.test.mjs 'poppler opens the repaired PDF', because this container's pdfdetach has saving switched off (untouched code). check_post_frontmatter and check_posts ok. inherited_keys.py: 0 new. Versions cited: EN 16931 validation-1.3.17 (6e35e0a), Peppol BIS 3.0.22 (38d693d), KoSIT xrechnung-schematron v2.6.0 (rules at 7e3ddbe, one changelog/build.xml-only commit after the tag), read with git ls-remote 2026-11-24.
